standard.summary: 像素损失类型：下列可选值说明含换档影响。
standard.effect: 不同枚举会改变算法目标、资源占用或导出兼容性。
standard.whenToUse: 先默认，再按显存/质量/兼容目标换档。
standard.avoidWhen: 未做短测对照前不要同时叠多个激进实验档。

optionDescriptions.l1: 像素 L1，对亮瞎/暗死没那么炸。
optionDescriptions.lpips: 按「看起来像不像」罚，算得贵，权重大了容易糊或风格飘。
optionDescriptions.hybrid: 像素和感知混着来，权重要自己拧。

standard_en.summary: The pixel loss type: the values below include what changing gear does.
standard_en.effect: Different enum values change the algorithm's target, its resource use, or export compatibility.
standard_en.whenToUse: Start on the default, then change gear according to your VRAM, quality or compatibility goal.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not stack several aggressive experimental gears before running a short controlled test.

optionDescriptions.l1: L1 over the pixels; less explosive on blown-out or crushed areas.
optionDescriptions.lpips: Punishes by how alike things look, which is expensive to compute; too large a weight easily blurs the image or lets the style drift.
optionDescriptions.hybrid: Mixes pixel and perceptual; you have to set the weights yourself.
